items.title: Government accused of misleading public on NDIS cuts
items.description: The federal government has been accused of selling its cuts to the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) as a crackdown on fraud, while instead pursuing billions of dollars of dramatic savings by slashing participant packages.

items.title: Doctor in tears over 'atypical' moles as social media craze causes concern
items.description: Skin specialists are sounding a warning about the potential cancer risks associated with unregulated peptides at the heart of a social media-driven beauty craze.

items.title: Emissions drop again, fuelling hopes Australia's hit a tipping point
items.description: Emissions are at their lowest point since the COVID pandemic shut down the economy, dropping 2.1 per cent over the year to December 2025.

items.title: Debate over house prices 'invokes terror' in politicians
items.description: Politicians have been hesitant to say whether prices should rise or fall, as both sides of politics feel the pressure of trying to appease voters who own and voters who are trying to buy.

items.title: China warns Australia 55pc beef tariffs could apply within days
items.description: China is cracking down on beef imports and says it is ready to slap Australia with an additional 55 per cent tariff in the coming days.

items.title: Israel has invaded deeper into Lebanon using this river crossing
items.description: Images of the first tanks to roll over Lebanon's Litani River were posted online this week. ABC NEWS Verify has found the spot where Israel's military crossed.

items.title: Women say getting a long-acting reversible contraceptive has been the 'best decision'
items.description: Misinformation, cost and a lack of trained providers have stopped many Australian women from accessing what doctors consider the most effective form of reversible contraception.

items.title: Town in shock after couple stabbed and alleged intruder shot
items.description: The Torrington community will meet to discuss security measures following an alleged home invasion and a couple's stabbing.

items.title: Live: Budget an attempt to combat 'economic dislocation', PM to tell summit
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is expected to tell a summit today that the federal government's budget measures are an attempt to push back against "economic dislocation".

items.title: Rumours, rifts and a reported resignation form a murky picture of a war-ravaged Iran
items.description: A report about the resignation of Iran's president earlier this week came at a turbulent moment for Iran's regime, which is grappling with frictions between moderates and hardliners as the war drags on.

items.title: Kumanjayi Little Baby's family were forced to leave home community, MP says
items.description: Member for Lingiari Marion Scrymgour says the mother of Kumanjayi Little Baby had been living in insecure housing in Alice Springs so she could access specialist support for her daughter, before the five-year-old's tragic death in April.

items.title: This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in 50 years. But this one is different
items.description: Tensions are running high as officials fight to stop the rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where aid workers tell the ABC they are already playing catch-up with the deadly disease.

items.title: Qualifier makes French Open history, reaching final against Russian teen star
items.description: Nineteen-year-old Mirra Andreeva reaches her first grand slam final at the French Open where she will take on Poland's Maja Chwalińska, the first qualifier to reach the Paris decider in the Open Era.

items.title: Public servant claims threat of $4m damages bill in golf course fight
items.description: A South Australian public servant taking the state government to court over a controversial redevelopment in the Adelaide Parklands says he will continue to fight the case despite it potentially leading to him losing his house or becoming bankrupt.

items.title: Looking for another show like Off Campus? Right this way
items.description: Hannah and Garrett's steamy love story might be on ice, but we've found more romance and yearning to tick your comfort-viewing boxes.

items.title: ABC news quiz: Mystery markings, a premature celebration and a 'Big' fight
items.description: You too could learn the dangers of celebrating too soon if you underestimate this week's news quiz.

items.title: A new documentary brings things home for the author of Dark Emu
items.description: A slow-cinema treasure, Grace McKenzie's documentary, Yumburra, traces author Bruce Pascoe's establishment of a farm.

items.title: Ancient tribes, military, trade and China's rise meet on this island
items.description: India's Great Nicobar Island is home to one of the world's last isolated tribes who are believed to have lived there for thousands of years, but a rising China is set to see it undergo a major transformation at the Indian government's insistence.

items.title: Melbourne Storm boss hails 'positive' talks with Tasmania to bring games south
items.description: Melbourne Storm chief executive Justin Rodski says he's "got no doubt" a deal with Tasmania can be reached if the commercial interests line up, following a round of courting from premier Jeremy Rockliff.

items.title: Bail matter adjourned for 13yo boy charged with violent extremist offences
items.description: The teenager's bail application has been adjourned until later this month and transferred to the Maryborough Children's Court.

items.title: Zelenskyy writes open letter inviting Putin to talks to end Ukraine war
items.description: An open letter is the first public message Mr Zelenskyy has written directly to Mr Putin since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in 2022.

items.title: Hezbollah rejects Lebanon ceasefire as Israeli strikes kill four
items.description: Iran has made a ceasefire in Lebanon a condition for any peace deal with Washington, and has suggested in recent days that it could intervene directly if Israel keeps up attacks there.

items.title: Experts suspect state policy is putting some farmers in artificial drought
items.description: A western New South Wales farmer says dams built next door have stopped all water flows onto his property, forcing him to graze and water his stock by the side of the road.

items.title: Portugal and Austria defeat Germany for UN Security Council seats
items.description: Portugal and Austria have defeated Germany for seats on the powerful but deeply divided UN Security Council in a hotly contested race after intense campaigning.

items.title: Sex discrimination commissioner slams gender definition proposal
items.description: Australia's sex discrimination commissioner condemns a proposal to reinstate biological definition of sexes as a "step back" for women.
